checks.name: llvm_sys_modular_arithmetic
checks.finding: LLVM mul/add have no nsw/nuw flags. u64 wrapping_mul(3)+wrapping_add(7) matches the i64 IR bitvector computation, including high-bit and maximum values.

checks.name: llvm_sys_jit_ownership
checks.finding: JIT function calls occur before disposing the engine and context. Module ownership transfers to the engine; no duplicate module disposal. Builder is disposed before engine. LLVM C header expressly allows null options with SizeOfOptions=0.

checks.name: inkwell_call_phi_and_signed_predicate
checks.finding: Signed SLT selects wrapping negation for negatives and twice(x)+1 for nonnegatives. i64::MIN and i64::MAX match wrapping arithmetic. Two functions, a real call, branch blocks and phi are present in the pre-JIT IR.

checks.name: inkwell_jit_lifetime
checks.finding: JitFunction retains ExecEngineInner according to the pinned inkwell source. No raw function pointer escapes; context is declared first and drops last.

checks.name: negative_verifier_cases
checks.finding: Both probes build a function with an unterminated basic block, require LLVM verifier failure, and only then emit invalid_module_rejected=true. The invalid module is never passed to the JIT.

checks.name: version_and_target_scope
checks.finding: Exact crate constraints and Cargo.lock bind inkwell0.6.0/llvm-sys181.2.0; runtime asserts LLVM18.1.8. Qualification text restricts the observed path to x86_64 native MCJIT.

counting_note.reason: llvm-sys special list duplicates 0,1,2,7,41 already in 0..999; call count is still accurately reported.
